message: Running command: cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'ls /gt/_work/ && find /gt/_work -name "*fuzz*" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20'

message.content:
So `Read_opcode` reads `0xFC` followed by another byte, producing a 16-bit opcode like `0xFC08`. Then `GetOpInfo(0xFC08)` returns `&c_operationsFC[0x08]` which is out of bounds since the table only has 8 entries (0x00-0x07).
